_comment: Ward polygons of Kochi Municipal Corporation (74 divisions), copied from the source named in provenance. Same shape as data/karnataka-ward-polygons.json: WGS84 integers at coordinate_scale, each ring encoded as [x0, y0, dx1, dy1, ...] and closed; a point is in a ward by the even-odd rule over all of its rings. Rebuild with: node infra/aws-central/tools/snapshot-india-wards.mjs --city KL/kochi

provenance.upstream: DataMeet: "the wards as of 2022, scraped from https://opensdi.kerala.gov.in/layers/opensdi_data:geonode:KSUDP_KCH_Ward_Boundary" (Kerala State Spatial Data Infrastructure).

provenance.attribution: Kochi Municipal Spatial Data (https://github.com/datameet/Municipal_Spatial_Data/blob/master/Kochi/KCH_wards.geojson) by DataMeet India community (http://datameet.org/), CC BY-SA 2.5 IN
provenance.vintage: The divisions as of 2022. Kerala re-delimited every local body in 2025.

overlap.method: share of a ward's 24x24 grid samples that a second ward of the body also holds
